text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 11: The raw ensemble band is too narrow, and rescaling the spread widens it'
text.tspan: Figure 11: The raw ensemble band is too narrow, and rescaling the spread

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Black line: actual power as a percentage of effective capacity. Blue shade: the band holding the middle 80% of the 51 ensemble members (10% to 90%) of the cleaned production forecast. Purple shade: the same band after the post hoc B1 spread calibration, which rescales each series' members about their mean using only past outcomes. The ensemble mean, and so the mean absolute error, is unchanged. A well-calibrated band holds the actual power 80% of the time. Each panel shows one forecast run from the weekly runs of the validation year (July 2025 to June 2026): the run with the median mean actual power in its first 7 days among the runs the calibration scored, chosen by the actual power alone.'
text.tspan: Black line: actual power as a percentage of effective capacity. Blue shade: the band holding the middle 80% of the
51 ensemble members (10% to 90%) of the cleaned production forecast. Purple shade: the same band after the post hoc
B1 spread calibration, which rescales each series' members about their mean using only past outcomes. The ensemble
mean, and so the mean absolute error, is unchanged.
A well-calibrated band holds the actual power 80% of the time. Each panel shows one forecast run from the weekly
runs of the validation year (July 2025 to June 2026): the run with the median mean actual power in its first 7 days
among the runs the calibration scored, chosen by the actual power alone.
